therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation and survival pathways
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective response rate by centrally assessed breast MRI and pathologic complete response rate

results.effect_size: ORR difference 10.71% (95% CI: 0.11-21.32) overall; 18.19% (95% CI: 2.57-33.81) in PIK3CA mutant patients
biomarker_changes: Ki67 reduction from baseline: -83.81% vs -80.44% at week 3
subgroup_findings: PIK3CA mutant patients showed greater benefit: ORR 56.2% vs 38.0% (p=0.0332)
PIK3CA wildtype patients showed no significant benefit: ORR 45.7% vs 40.4% (p=0.5017)
Pathologic complete response rates were low in both groups (1.8% vs 0.6%)
safety_signals: Serious diarrhea events: 5 patients in taselisib arm
results.dose_information: Taselisib 4 mg daily (two 2 mg tablets) on 5 days-on/2 days-off schedule for 16 weeks; Letrozole 2.5 mg daily for 16 weeks
